pages.title: Experience needed per level
text: Experience required to go from level L−1 to level L:
The two segments join seamlessly at level 200: level 200 costs 4080 and level 201 costs 4504. All parameters live in the general.xp section (linear_until_level, linear_base, linear_step, log_scale).

pages.title: Sampling table
text: Cumulative experience: 109,000 for level 100; 418,000 for level 200; 1,051,430 for level 300; 2,511,411 for level 500.
Closed form for the linear segment: 10 * L^2 + 90 * L (L <= 200).
There is no level cap; the logarithmic segment merely makes the late-game requirement grow very slowly.

pages.title: Levels and points
text: One point per level, so at level L you have earned L points in total.
Available points = level minus everything invested across the 26 lines.

For example, level 200 gives 200 points - 7.7 per line on average - and level 500 gives 500 points, 19 per line. Now that every line is linear with per_point equal to the old curve's initial slope (cap/half), the first 20 points buy at least as much as before: roughly 20%..50% of the old cap, depending on whether that line's half was 100 or 40.
